description: Sanity ecosystem presets, then Roboto policy LAST so it wins - preset packageRules are appended in order and the last matching rule sets each option.

packageRules.description: The Studio is held on the @sanity/ui v3 / @sanity/icons v3 line by sanity-plugin-lucide-icon-picker: 1.0.3 is its last release, and it imports Popover/Menu from the @sanity/ui root and TrashIcon/SyncIcon/EllipsisHorizontalIcon from the @sanity/icons root - all moved to subpaths in @sanity/ui v4 / @sanity/icons v4, so `sanity build` fails with MISSING_EXPORT the moment either crosses. Capped rather than disabled so fixes inside v3 still land. Crossing means replacing that plugin; lift both caps together when it happens.

Held at 7 to match the catalog: next-sanity 13 imports `unstable__adapter`, which @sanity/client 8 removed, and next build dies loading next.config.ts. Lift when next-sanity ships a v8-compatible release.
